name: project-resource-plan
title: Project resource plan
for_each: select id,name from projects order by name

sections.title: Named commitments
sections.sql: select p.name,b.start_on,b.end_on,b.daily_hours,b.status,b.note from bookings b join people p on p.id=b.person_id where project_id=$1 order by start_on,p.name

sections.title: Staffing still needed
sections.sql: select role,skill,start_on,end_on,daily_hours,owner from requests where project_id=$1 and status='open'

name: staffing-brief
title: Staffing request brief
for_each: select q.id,p.name from requests q join projects p on p.id=q.project_id

sections.title: Decision history
sections.sql: select actor,action,detail,created_at from activity where entity_id=$1 order by created_at,id
